name: Cazul
summary: In the Cleft of Shadow, Cazul guides young warlocks toward greater command of demons. Blind and ancient, he remains a keeper of old orc warlock traditions.

sections.title: Eyes in the Dark
sections.body: Cazul waits in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar, where rising warlocks seek his counsel. Blind though he is, he senses the currents of the Twisting Nether and hears the whispers of demons. Those who want to master their craft and bind more dangerous servitors are often sent to him. His sight is gone, but his arcane power remains.

faq.answer: Cazul is an elderly, blind orc warlock who lives in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He advises aspiring warlocks in dark sorcery and demonology.

aliases: how did cazul lose his sight
faq.answer: No record tells why Cazul is blind.

faq.q: What role does Cazul play for warlocks?
faq.answer: Cazul guides warlocks seeking to advance their craft, especially those learning to summon and bind a succubus.

angles.text: As a warlock of the Horde, you can seek Cazul's guidance in the Cleft of Shadow when you want to bind deeper powers from the Nether.
As an orc, you can see in Cazul the enduring presence of dark magic among your people. He practices away from the watchful eyes of Thrall's honor guard.
